Coco Gauff defends mother over US Open ticket requests

Tennis player Coco Gauff has defended her mother's decision to publicly post about excessive ticket requests from family and friends for the US Open. Gauff stated that her mother was trying to manage the situation and that she herself would not have handled it differently. The issue arose from numerous requests for tickets to the tournament.
